operating_themes.title: AI-enabled engineering workflows
operating_themes.body: GenAI and MLOps solutioning in the platform, plus public applied-AI architectures with explainability in the open.

featured_tutorial.intro: A personal analytics product operators can run themselves — from export to dashboard — rather than a tool walkthrough. Outcome first; tools last.

metis_bootcamp.intro: Bootcamp work framed as the decision or user it served — campaign placement, score prediction, vessel monitoring, claim review, generative verse — not as a tool catalogue.

linkedin-analytics-databricks.outcome: Give a professional a first-party LinkedIn analytics workspace they can run themselves — from export to dashboard — without waiting on vendor reporting.
linkedin-analytics-databricks.scope: Public tutorial series documenting the end-to-end data product for educational reuse.

metis-mta-edaproject.outcome: Point a campaign toward the stations where footfall actually concentrates, using public turnstile counts.
metis-mta-edaproject.scope: Exploratory analysis of NYC MTA station usage and a placement recommendation.

metis-animelist-score-prediction.outcome: Surface which titles the crowd over- or under-rates, so a catalog decision is not just a raw score.
metis-animelist-score-prediction.scope: Scraping, feature engineering, regression, and bias analysis on MyAnimeList scores.

metis-global-fishing-watch.outcome: Separate fishing from other maritime traffic at F1 0.90 and AUC 0.98, so activity can be monitored rather than inspected by hand.
metis-global-fishing-watch.scope: Supervised classification on Global Fishing Watch vessel data.

metis-fake-news-detection.outcome: Route dubious claims to review instead of treating every statement as equal — automated fact-checking on the LIAR dataset.
metis-fake-news-detection.scope: NLP, topic modeling, and word embeddings for claim classification.

metis-generative-poetry-lstm.outcome: Let a reader generate original verse in the browser, as a small creative product rather than a training-loop write-up.
metis-generative-poetry-lstm.scope: LSTM text generation with a Flask and PostgreSQL path to the page.
